svg.title: CycleSideChick — Architecture & Core Capabilities
svg.desc: A comprehensive visual infographic illustrating CycleSideChick's on-device privacy, statistical cycle engine v2, dynamic calendar, daily biometric logging, and clinician care reports.

g.text: A Private, Evidence-Based Menstrual & Reproductive Health Companion
Prioritizes recent endocrine shifts over old history.
Prevents isolated stress/travel from skewing math.
Eliminates false certainty; labels all dates "Estimated".
Customizes estimated ovulation to user biology.
Flow, pain, cervical mucus, mood, sleep & hydration
Clinical red-flag triggers & private on-device Q&A
Evidence-based answers citing ACOG, NHS & WHO over user data.
Zero prompt transmission; never replaces licensed medical advice.
CycleSideChick v2.0.0 • 100% On-Device Single Page & Offline PWA • Mathematical estimations are approximations, not medical diagnoses.
